body.purpose: Interface and study text, including Vietnamese explanations.

display-accent.purpose: Emphasized word in the dashboard greeting.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Button and navigation color or border changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Removes smooth scrolling and minimizes animations and transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action for starting or submitting a study task.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 38px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--accent); color: white; font: 600 12px 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-2); border-color: var(--accent-2); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 48%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action beside a primary study action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { min-height: 38px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink-2); font: 600 12px 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 42%, var(--line)); background: var(--accent-soft-2); color: var(--accent); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 48%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Shared native field treatment for forms and writing tasks.
components.css: .ds-field-wrap { display: grid; gap: 5px; color: var(--ink-2); font: 500 11px 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; } .ds-field { width: 100%; min-height: 40px; padding: 9px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 8px; outline: 0; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font: 400 14px/1.55 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; transition: border-color .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-field:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 35%, transparent); border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-field:disabled { opacity: .52; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Sidebar destination with quiet hover and clear active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; min-height: 42px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 9px; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; font: 500 13px 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; transition: background .16s ease, color .16s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 48%, transparent); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"]::before { position: absolute; left: -2px; top: 9px; bottom: 9px; width: 3px; border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; background: var(--accent); content: ''; }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Resting white surface for study summaries and task content.
components.html:
Today’s progress

Keep your next study step in view.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 19px 22px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(28, 48, 35, .018); font-family: 'Be Vietnam Pro', sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.55; }

components.name: Study Allocation Strip
components.description: Three semantic progress segments for the daily study allocation.
components.css: .ds-allocation { height: 11px; display: flex; gap: 5px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9px; } .ds-segment { min-width: 2px; flex: 1; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface-2); } .ds-segment i { display: block; width: 55%; height: 100%; border-radius: inherit; } .ds-sage { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--sage) 23%, var(--surface-2)); } .ds-sage i { background: var(--sage); } .ds-blue { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--blue) 24%, var(--surface-2)); } .ds-blue i { background: var(--blue); } .ds-amber { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--amber) 22%, var(--surface-2)); } .ds-amber i { background: var(--amber); }

narrative.overview:
FluentPath is a calm, practical workspace for returning to English study. A warm off-white ground, forest actions, quiet borders, and restrained status colors keep attention on the next useful learning step. Be Vietnam Pro supports Vietnamese explanations and English practice; a Georgia italic accent adds a small human note to display greetings.

The interface uses familiar native controls, clear interaction states, and generous reading space. Light is the default; a complete dark palette preserves the same semantic roles. Motion is brief and functional, with reduced-motion preferences respected.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-like light surfaces with dark ink and forest actions.
Semantic sage, amber, blue, and red status treatments.
Quietly rounded controls and lightly layered panels.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Use status colors for their established study meaning; never rely on color alone to communicate a result.

dos: Do use Be Vietnam Pro for interface and study text so Vietnamese explanations remain legible.
Do reserve Georgia italic for the existing display accent.
Do keep interactive controls semantic, keyboard visible, and clearly stateful.
Do map sage, blue, and amber to the established study allocation categories.
donts: Don't invent additional status colors or use semantic colors as decoration.
Don't use color alone for selection, errors, or progress meaning.
Don't compress practice reading into the denser interface text rhythm.
